title: JPL Viking mission lead believed there was evidence of life on Mars

tellings.quote: I've heard that the JPL guy who was in charge of the Viking missions also swears by there being sort of, you know, evidence of life on Mars

plain: The man in charge of the Viking missions, NASA's 1970s landers sent to Mars, firmly believes there was evidence of life on Mars, Jesse Michels says. The man worked at JPL, NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, which builds and runs its robot space probes. Michels says only that he has "heard" this, without naming the man or a source. If true, a scientist who led the search would believe it found life on another world.
